anti_tailoring_checks: Prompt echo in receipts must match the submitted fresh prompt exactly.
Generated UI should match the fresh noun and intent, not reuse old visible labels from prior prompt sets when inappropriate.
Generated file paths may be model-authored, but report whether they suspiciously reuse old benchmark-specific names.
No proxy_exact_target_suggested should appear for these blunt disposable prompts.
fallback_used and deterministic_scaffold_used must remain false.
Behavior probes must verify the fresh prompt's obvious interaction, not a generic open-only condition.
If the model refuses, returns prose, or creates no behavior, mark NEEDS_FIX or FAIL explicitly.

prompts.anti_tailoring_note: Snack break wording should not depend on exact timer app text.
prompts.expected_behavior: Start/stop or countdown/count-up timer visibly changes over time.

prompts.anti_tailoring_note: Split bill intent with different messy wording should still calculate visibly.
prompts.expected_behavior: Entering bill/tip/people changes a visible per-person or total result.

prompts.anti_tailoring_note: Theme behavior should generalize beyond exact dark theme phrasing.
prompts.expected_behavior: A control visibly switches page colors or theme state.
prompts.prompt: make a day night color toggle

prompts.anti_tailoring_note: Checklist mutation should generalize beyond todo wording.
prompts.expected_behavior: User can add at least one fridge item and see it persist in the list during the session.

prompts.anti_tailoring_note: Weather-like card should not depend on exact weather card demo phrase.
prompts.expected_behavior: Shows weather-like fields and any update/control changes visible forecast state or content.

prompts.anti_tailoring_note: Player control behavior should transfer to audio show wording.
prompts.expected_behavior: Visible play/pause or next control changes player state.
prompts.prompt: make a small audio show player

prompts.anti_tailoring_note: Counter/tracker behavior should not be hardcoded only to habit wording.
prompts.expected_behavior: User can add/increment/check off water progress and see state change.
prompts.prompt: make a cup counter for water

prompts.anti_tailoring_note: Notes behavior should remain interactive and show saved typed text.
prompts.expected_behavior: User can type and save/add a note, with visible note text after action.
prompts.prompt: make a fast sticky notes app

prompts.anti_tailoring_note: Strength checker should generalize to weak/strong meter wording.
prompts.expected_behavior: Typing weak vs stronger passwords changes a visible safety/strength label.
prompts.prompt: make a password weak strong meter

prompts.anti_tailoring_note: Drawing behavior should generalize beyond drawing pad exact text.
prompts.expected_behavior: Pointer/mouse input on a canvas or drawing area visibly marks the board.

purpose: Third messy-human prompt set using the same broad simple UI categories as random 10 and 10b, with different wording to catch prompt-specific branches, hidden templates, deterministic fallbacks, or hand-held benchmark behavior.
rules_for_future_run: Do not tune generation prompts for this set.
Do not add prompt-specific branches, aliases, templates, or hidden fallback snippets.
Do not patch generated artifacts after the model writes them except through the bounded generic post-behavior repair loop.
Do not activate sidecars or cloud/API fallback unless separately approved.
Preserve raw prompt text, selected route, task_spec_intake, model transcript, parsed actions, workspace diff, score, browser open result, repair evidence, and behavior probe evidence.
Treat PASS as behavior-proven main interaction, not just file creation, openable HTML, route GO, or parser success.
title: Anti-tailoring random 10c blunt prompt challenge
